nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances of UniswapExchange; mutated in transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting per-address sale transfers; incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist flag set by _mints and read by ensure.
Private minimum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Private per-address sale-count limit, set in init and enforced in condition.
Address allowed to bypass ensure(); set by setTradeAddress, owner-controlled.
Privileged owner address assigned in constructor from msg.sender; gates _mints, init, delegate, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public total token supply assigned in constructor from _supply with 10**decimals scaling.
Constant uint public decimals = 18, used for scaling in init, _mints and constructor.
Constant address of Uniswap router used as whitelisted source in ensure().
Public payable transfer() that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value); non-standard ERC20 entry point.
Internal view whitelist gate; returns true for owner/UNI/canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition().
Public payable transferFrom doing unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic, ensure() and per-address sale counting before emitting Transfer.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no return-value safety and emits Approval.
Internal view validating _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale against _onSaleNum and _value.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall to arbitrary user-supplied target and calldata; critical dangerous primitive.
Privileged mint/whitelist function granting arbitrary balance to spender and setting canSale[spender]=true.
Owner-only initializer setting sale-count and min/max sale limits with 10**decimals scaling.
Owner-only batch distribution computing total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked arithmetic and a loop.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress whitelist.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256 for whitelist checks.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender and a max allowance to the Uniswap router.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance bookkeeping and owner assignment.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary external code in the contract storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath or underflow guard.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed with unchecked arithmetic.
total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed after a non-strict >= require, checked-subtraction.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) writes balances directly with weak authorization (address comparison).

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) to pass before moving balances.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair whitelist address.
delegate() performs an external delegatecall to attacker-controlled address and calldata.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] and is trusted as the spender identity.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using caller identity.
_mints() authorizes via msg.sender==owner or a hardcoded address comparison.
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and initial supply balances.
transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from source into transferFrom.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] with plain unchecked arithmetic.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the balanceOf state variable.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
Unchecked addition mutates the balanceOf state variable.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without overflow-safe math.
Allowance subtraction writes the allowance state variable.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
_mints directly overwrites balanceOf for an arbitrary spender with weak authorization.
Arbitrary mint primitive writes the balanceOf state variable.
